tldr: Cover page and acknowledgments for the Oregon Prosperity Council's June 2026 report to Governor Tina Kotek titled 'Recommendations for Oregon's Long-Term Competitiveness & Prosperity.' The report is co-led by Renée James (Ampere Computing) and Curtis Robinhold (Port of Portland), with a 13-member council representing Oregon business, labor, and nonprofit sectors. It acknowledges support from ECOnorthwest and Gard Communications, and input from Oregonians throughout the engagement process.

bullets.text: Report published June 2026 by the Oregon Prosperity Council
Co-Chairs: Renée James (Ampere Computing) and Curtis Robinhold (Port of Portland)
13 Council Members representing Oregon's business, labor, agricultural, construction, and nonprofit sectors
Support from consultants ECOnorthwest and Gard Communications
Report incorporates ideas and perspectives from many Oregonians throughout the engagement process
